Method of Attack: Overrides legitimate CCXT API entries to redirect trading requests to a malicious server
Uses obfuscation techniques (base64 encoding, nested eval calls) to hide and run arbitrary code
Impacted Systems: Python environments using the ccxt-mexc-futures package for MEXC futures trading
Attack Vector: Installation of the malicious package via PyPI
Use of overridden API entries to send requests to a malicious server
